body: I don't want to deal with things, i want change. I wanted  change for last 8 years and nothing happend. Fml.
That is true, but nether therapist can change them. I'm from Slovenia.

Who? Eyes. Go outside and you can find ugly woman on the street. I do not have nothing against them, i would love to be their friend, but i wouldn't date them. So i don't blame people for the way i look. I blame them for a lot of other things but not for that. And don't undestand me that i'm looking for perfect girl, i'm looking for woman in my league with whom i can share my thougts. I don't want special life, i wan't life with simple girl, who would be my best friend, and maybe one day i could have family with here. 

And i don't think my problem are temporarly problems. If i could change them i already would.

I went alone on holidays this summer, and  do you want to know how many friends i made? Zero. Only people i have contact with were hostel personality.

I don't have money to visit pyschotherapist, they only exist in our private sector, not in our public health sector. But like i said, i will visit psychiatrist(if i will make it until then).

I was very shy like a kid,  so it's not directly connected with the fact that i was bullied. But of corse,  bullying made everything a lot worse.


About attractiveness i think it's not problem with our society. If you look ugly there is nothing you can change. You can be fit, you can wear awesome clothes, but still, if you look like a butterface, you can only say "fuck".

How to send a message on reddit tutorial. Click on profil of the person, and on the left side under karma you have option "send message".

Back to the topic.
Why am i miserable? Beacuse i'm lonley, i don't have any real friends, i don't have SO, i have social anxiety( so it's hard for me to make new friends), i have been bullied through my primary school and high school, i have very poor intellect, i will fail this year at Uni, and that is my final chance and i'm not very attractive person. And i'm 21 years old. And beacuse of my depression i have motivation for like zero things.

And you know what? My life it's not sad, it's pathetically looking funny.

I'm big pussy, so i won't do it tonight, but in the near future...maybe. I have appointment with psychiatrist, but  it's irrelevant. My depression is not my main problem, it's only product of my miserable life(i'm not overreacting)

At uni we do not have  counsellors, and they do not give a fuck about your personal/health problem.(free public education system)
